storagePowerOnHours.description: Disk power-on hours. Strong signal when SMART is available.

storageWritesGb.description: Total host writes in GB for SSD/NVMe.

storageHealth.description: SMART health percent. Lower means worse condition.

batteryCycles.description: Battery cycle count. Ignored automatically on desktops.

batteryWear.description: Battery wear percent computed from design/full charge capacity.

windowsInstallAge.description: Windows install age in days. Weak signal because reinstalling Windows resets it.
